user_invitation_live_uq.name: user_invitation_live_uq
user_invitation_live_uq.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

user_invitation_live_employee_uq.name: user_invitation_live_employee_uq
user_invitation_live_employee_uq.where: employee_id is not null and accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

leave_txn_sign_ck.name: leave_txn_sign_ck
leave_txn_sign_ck.value:
("leave_txn"."kind"::text in ('DEBIT', 'CARRY_OUT', 'ENCASHMENT', 'LAPSE') and "leave_txn"."days_hundredths" < 0)
    or ("leave_txn"."kind"::text in ('GRANT', 'ACCRUAL', 'REVERSAL', 'CARRY_IN') and "leave_txn"."days_hundredths" > 0)
    or "leave_txn"."kind"::text in ('OPENING', 'ADJUSTMENT')
